info.title: AstroIllustrator API
info.description: Schema 2.1 deterministic astronomy API. Rendering is synchronous; job requestJson/resultJson remain serialized JSON strings. Local-first host; authentication is not implemented.

get.description: Actual installed renderer capabilities and conservative offline IERS observation coverage. Cached for up to 30 seconds; not a guarantee of every scientific request.

Checks database connectivity, Python imports, catalogs, bundled IERS and writable artifact/cache storage. Does not create a render or guarantee future requests; renderer checks cached up to 30 seconds.

post.description: Synchronous render, returning a completed job with 201 and Location. Validation failures create no job. Scientific/renderer failures can include jobId/code. Disconnecting does not guarantee no persisted job; no automatic POST retries.

Location.description: Relative URL of the created resource

post.description: Resolves civil time and nominal year bounds only. Consult capabilities and render validation for actual IERS support.

get.description: Completed-job SVG, PNG or manifest attachment. File SHA-256 is in output metadata. Manifest has independent scientific provenance and is not recursively self-hashed.

IllustrationRequest.description: Exactly one non-null matching scientific payload. Omitted scalar properties retain schema 2.1 defaults; unknown members are rejected. Further scene-dependent rules are enforced by the backend validator.

localDateTime.description: Local civil timestamp without UTC offset. Requires IANA timeZoneId; Reject/Earlier/Later resolves DST overlaps. Gaps are rejected.
